output.text: Boxed collectible figure. Turn the person or pet in each photo into a small collectible figure standing inside a clear plastic blister pack, mounted on a printed card backing, with one small prop related to the subject beside the figure in the pack. Keep the subject recognizable: for people keep the face, hair and glasses; for pets keep the fur color and markings. Glossy molded-plastic finish, clean product-photo lighting on a plain backdrop. No brands, logos, text, known characters or artist styles.
